description: This file contains API service functions for managing wireless network configurations, including fetching and updating WLAN basic, advanced, WPS, and mesh settings, with mock data support for development environment.

methods.name: getWlanBasic
methods.description: Fetches basic WLAN configuration, returns mock data in development mode.

methods.name: updateWlanBasic
methods.description: Updates basic WLAN configuration via API or mock data.

methods.name: getWlanAdvanced
methods.description: Fetches advanced WLAN settings, returns mock data in development mode.

methods.name: updateWlanAdvanced
methods.description: Updates advanced WLAN settings, with data transformation in development mode.

methods.name: getWlanWps
methods.description: Fetches WLAN WPS configuration, returns mock data in development mode.

methods.name: updateWlanWps
methods.description: Updates WLAN WPS configuration via API or mock data.

methods.name: getWlanMesh
methods.description: Fetches WLAN mesh settings, returns mock data in development mode.

methods.name: updateWlanMesh
methods.description: Updates WLAN mesh settings via API or mock data.
